title: On higher-order differential equations for Laguerre-Hahn orthogonal polynomials
summary: In this work, we present a constructive method to derive homogeneous linear differential equations of arbitrary order for Laguerre--Hahn orthogonal polynomials. The approach is based on a hierarchy of structure relations, built recursively from the fundamental structure relation of the Laguerre--Hahn forms. The fourth-order differential equation, which has been extensively studied in the literature, is naturally recovered as a particular case of this general framework.
